text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?
reply_text:
I replied in #inc-vtg-hartford, in the thread under your question.

You first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug. The guard appears only in that same post, writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. The channel doesn't describe the guard again until 11:03 AM, when Mateo reported kiosk 1 back and the guard checked in trailer 8836. Your 11:08 AM post says both lanes were working as of 11:07.

The channel records when the outage was reported, not when it started. If the postmortem needs the start time or more on the guard's activity, that would be in the INC-4821 ticket or in Odile's reconnect log, which I can't see from here.

text: And mine: which ticket holds the status-page screenshot for Mateo's access problem?
reply_text: The status-page screenshot for Mateo's access problem is attached to ticket INC-4821. Gideon's 11:08 AM post on 3 Aug says so. I replied to you in the thread under your question. The channel doesn't show whether the access issue was resolved.
